headlines.title: Apple Is Just $42 Billion Away From Passing Nvidia as the World’s Most Valuable Company
headlines.summary: Apple just hit a record close while Nvidia shed billions in a brutal sector selloff, and the gap between the two most valuable companies on earth has shrunk to a fraction of what it was one week ago.

headlines.title: Microsoft Has a $1 Trillion Opportunity Hiding in Plain Sight
headlines.summary: Azure just crossed a milestone that has analysts quietly raising their ceiling for Microsoft, but the real story is buried in a contract number that almost nobody is talking about.

headlines.title: AI agents are inside U.S. bank accounts. But nobody knows how.
headlines.summary: Major U.S. banks are detecting unauthorized AI agents inside customer accounts, and they can't tell them apart from humans. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the worst 48 hours in cybersecurity, from a leaked PHP flaw affecting an estimated 70% of websites to a hacking group turning AI agents on Latin American financial targets, and how to protect yourself.

headlines.title: Google and Voltus expand virtual power plant to 1GW in PJM
headlines.summary: The partnership will aggregate energy from businesses and homes, offering bill savings and payments for grid support.

headlines.title: If a Stock Market Crash Is on the Way, Warren Buffett Says This Is the Best Thing Investors Can Do for Their Portfolio
headlines.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are sliding, making portfolio structure increasingly important.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
